CREATE TABLE person (person_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); CREATE TABLE phone (phone_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, person_id INTEGER, can_receive_sms INTEGER); Who doesn't have a way for us to text them? 
SELECT p.person_id, p.name
FROM person p
LEFT JOIN phone ph ON p.person_id = ph.person_id AND ph.can_receive_sms = 1
WHERE ph.phone_id IS NULL;
 -- Pokemon database (SQLite). This file is also pasted into the AI prompt,
-- so the comments are there to help the model write correct SQL.

CREATE TABLE type (
    type_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE              -- e.g. 'fire', 'water', 'grass'
);

CREATE TABLE pokemon (
    pokemon_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,        -- Pokedex number
    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,             -- lowercase, e.g. 'pikachu'
    generation INTEGER NOT NULL,           -- 1, 2, 3, ...
    height_m REAL,                         -- meters
    weight_kg REAL,                        -- kilograms
    base_experience INTEGER,
    is_legendary INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- 1 = legendary or mythical, 0 = not
    hp INTEGER NOT NULL,                   -- base stats
    attack INTEGER NOT NULL,
    defense INTEGER NOT NULL,
    special_attack INTEGER NOT NULL,
    special_defense INTEGER NOT NULL,
    speed INTEGER NOT NULL
);

-- A pokemon has one or two types (many-to-many)
CREATE TABLE pokemon_type (
    pokemon_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    type_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    slot INTEGER NOT NULL,                 -- 1 = primary type, 2 = secondary type
    PRIMARY KEY (pokemon_id, type_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (pokemon_id) REFERENCES pokemon (pokemon_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (type_id) REFERENCES type (type_id)
);

CREATE TABLE ability (
    ability_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE              -- e.g. 'static', 'overgrow'
);

CREATE TABLE pokemon_ability (
    pokemon_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ability_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    is_hidden INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- 1 = hidden ability
    PRIMARY KEY (pokemon_id, ability_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (pokemon_id) REFERENCES pokemon (pokemon_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (ability_id) REFERENCES ability (ability_id)
);

-- Damage multiplier when an attack of one type hits a defender of another type.
-- 0 = no effect, 0.5 = not very effective, 1 = normal, 2 = super effective.
-- For a dual-type defender, multiply the two rows together.
CREATE TABLE type_effectiveness (
    attacking_type_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    defending_type_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    multiplier REAL NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (attacking_type_id, defending_type_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (attacking_type_id) REFERENCES type (type_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (defending_type_id) REFERENCES type (type_id)
);
 Which pokemon have two types? 
SELECT p.name
FROM pokemon p
JOIN pokemon_type pt ON p.pokemon_id = pt.pokemon_id
GROUP BY p.pokemon_id
HAVING COUNT(*) = 2;

questionResults.question: Which pokemon has the highest attack?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT name
FROM pokemon
ORDER BY attack DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The Pokémon with the highest attack is Dragonite.

questionResults.question: What are the top 3 fastest pokemon?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT name
FROM pokemon
ORDER BY speed DESC
LIMIT 3;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The top 3 fastest Pokémon are Electrode, Jolteon, and Aerodactyl.

questionResults.question: Which pokemon have more than one type?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT p.name
FROM pokemon p
JOIN pokemon_type pt ON p.pokemon_id = pt.pokemon_id
GROUP BY p.pokemon_id
HAVING COUNT(pt.type_id) > 1;

questionResults.question: Which fire type pokemon have the highest special attack?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT p.name
FROM pokemon p
JOIN pokemon_type pt ON p.pokemon_id = pt.pokemon_id
JOIN type t ON pt.type_id = t.type_id
WHERE t.name = 'fire'
ORDER BY p.special_attack DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The fire type Pokémon with the highest special attack is Moltres.

questionResults.question: Which pokemon are weak to water attacks?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT p.name
FROM pokemon p
JOIN pokemon_type pt ON p.pokemon_id = pt.pokemon_id
JOIN type t ON pt.type_id = t.type_id
JOIN type_effectiveness te ON t.type_id = te.defending_type_id
WHERE te.attacking_type_id = (SELECT type_id FROM type WHERE name = 'water') AND te.multiplier > 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The Pokémon that are weak to water attacks include: Charmander, Charmeleon, Charizard, Sandshrew, Sandslash, Nidoqueen, Nidoking, Vulpix, Ninetales, Diglett, Dugtrio, Growlithe, Arcanine, Geodude, Graveler, Golem, Ponyta, Rapidash, Onix, Cubone, Marowak, Rhyhorn, Rhydon, Magmar, Flareon, Omanyte, Omastar, Kabuto, Kabutops, Aerodactyl, Moltres, Cyndaquil, Quilava, Typhlosion, Sudowoodo, Wooper, Quagsire, Gligar, Steelix, Shuckle, Slugma, Magcargo, Swinub, Piloswine, Corsola, Houndour, Houndoom, Phanpy, Donphan, Magby, Entei, Larvitar, Pupitar, and Tyranitar, as well as Ho-Oh.

questionResults.question: Which of the previous pokemon are also legendary?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT p.name
FROM pokemon p
JOIN pokemon_type pt ON p.pokemon_id = pt.pokemon_id
JOIN type t ON pt.type_id = t.type_id
JOIN type_effectiveness te ON t.type_id = te.defending_type_id
WHERE te.attacking_type_id = (SELECT type_id FROM type WHERE name = 'water') AND te.multiplier > 1
AND p.is_legendary = 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The legendary Pokémon that are super effective against water types are Moltres, Entei, and Ho-Oh.

questionResults.question: Which pokemon have a lot of hp and would be good for a tank in battle?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT p.name
FROM pokemon p
WHERE p.hp >= 100
ORDER BY p.hp DESC;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Here are the Pokémon with high HP that would be good for a tank in battle: Blissey, Chansey, Wobbuffet, Snorlax, Wigglytuff, Lapras, Vaporeon, Lanturn, Jigglypuff, Entei, Mewtwo, Lugia, Ho-Oh, Muk, Rhydon, Kangaskhan, Mew, Noctowl, Azumarill, Dunsparce, Piloswine, Suicune, Tyranitar, and Celebi.

questionResults.question: Which pokemon have the ability of 'intimidate'?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT p.name
FROM pokemon p
JOIN pokemon_ability pa ON p.pokemon_id = pa.pokemon_id
JOIN ability a ON pa.ability_id = a.ability_id
WHERE a.name = 'intimidate';
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The Pokémon with the ability 'intimidate' are: Arbok, Arcanine, Ekans, Granbull, Growlithe, Gyarados, Hitmontop, Qwilfish, Snubbull, Stantler, and Tauros.

questionResults.question: Who is the strongest pokemon?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT p.name
FROM pokemon p
ORDER BY p.attack + p.defense + p.special_attack + p.special_defense + p.speed DESC
LIMIT 1;
